quotes: unless a family member expresses a clear preference for a different spacing.
If you receive applications from several family members, you should space the last names consistently, unless a family member expresses a clear preference for a different spacing.
judgments.rationale: The proposed qualification record accurately identifies the explicit exception in 8 FAM 403.1-3(B) NOTE and correctly targets baseline claim C0018, which embodies the recommendation to space family members' last names consistently. Making this prose caveat into an explicit qualification edge linking to C0018 is legitimate, preserves the scope and conditions of the source text, and faithfully captures the actor ('a family member'), action, and object without distorting modal force or neighboring duties.
